summary: Executed backend+frontend regression on public URL for deposit/expense rules engine, ledger sourcing, UI options, setup download, and auth playbook checks. Core requested accounting features passed; two auth regressions remain.

critical.issue: Preflight response on public endpoint does not include Access-Control-Allow-Credentials=true and returns missing credentialed CORS headers.
Lockout is enforced before 5 failed attempts (received 429 during first five attempts), conflicting with documented lockout-after-5 requirement.

ui_bugs.issue: Browser console logs React hydration warning: invalid markup (<span> inside <option>) while rendering account options.

action_items: Fix auth preflight headers on public edge so credentialed CORS returns explicit origin + Access-Control-Allow-Credentials=true.
Align login lockout threshold with playbook/test_credentials policy (5 failed attempts) or update docs and UX copy consistently.
Fix invalid DOM rendering in ledger account <option> tree to remove hydration warning.
Keep iteration49 regression test in CI for deposit/expense-to-ledger mapping coverage.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py remains very large and monolithic (>700 lines), increasing regression risk for accounting rule changes.
Lockout constants and error message text are hardcoded around 3 attempts, diverging from current playbook expectations.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary ITER49 deposits and expenses via API during tests; cleanup performed in test teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Requested business scope passed on public endpoint: deposit creates deposit+deposit_interest journals, deleting deposit removes both journals, expense categories hajj_umrah/meat_installment/union_committee map to 5104/5105/5106, /api/ledger account_code 1250 and 5104/5105/5106 validated from journal_entries, expenses UI shows new category options, ledger UI shows chart accounts list and export buttons render, /api/download/setup returns valid MZ EXE matching /app/dist size. Remaining failures are auth CORS + lockout threshold mismatch.
rca of the issue: RCA-1 CORS: app code sets credentialed CORS, but public OPTIONS response headers are missing required credential flags, indicating ingress/edge override or middleware order mismatch in deployed path. RCA-2 lockout: LOGIN_LOCKOUT_FAILED_ATTEMPTS is set to 3 in backend/server.py, so runtime behavior contradicts current test_credentials/playbook text expecting lockout after 5 attempts. MOCKED INTEGRATION: Electronic Invoice external ETA submission remains MOCKED/BLOCKED pending official ETA SDK/credentials.
